key.name: animate-icon
key.description: Rotate the drawer button arrow smoothly when the drawer opens or closes. When disabled, the arrow still changes direction, but without animation.

key.name: rotate-icon
key.summary: Rotate the drawer button arrow when opening
key.description: Flip the drawer button arrow when the drawer is open, so it points back towards the panel edge. This is independent of the animation: when disabled, the arrow keeps pointing in the configured direction.

key.name: icon-direction
key.description: Direction the drawer button arrow points to when the drawer is closed. With "auto" the arrow points away from the panel edge, so it follows panels placed at the top, bottom, left or right.
